task_description: Elementwise y = x*scale+bias over a (1024, 128) bf16 array via pltpu.emit_pipeline, comparing input buffer_count=2 (double buffering, 1-block lookahead) against buffer_count=3 (triple buffering, 2-block lookahead).

metrics.name: dma_wait_fraction
metrics.description: same metric as 04_async_pipeline -- fraction of kernel time spent waiting on DMA. This cell's naive/optimized delta only shows up when per-block DMA latency exceeds per-block compute time (otherwise 2 buffers are already enough to fully hide the transfer, and buffer_count=3 buys nothing). Needs a real profiler trace (agent/profiler.py, not yet implemented) to observe directly.

known_gotcha: buffer_count > 2 is only supported for INPUT buffered refs in this jax/jaxlib version -- setting it on an output BlockSpec raises NotImplementedError('Buffer count >2 not supported for output buffered refs'). Found by trying it, not documented anywhere obvious.
